reasoning_traces.think:
The primitives define core performance kernels for rushing, quarterbacking, and receiving. YAC×avoided tackles captures physical resilience and efficiency in running. QBR+EPA/Play offers a composite measure of quarterback impact, integrating both outcome and process. WOPR reflects receiver utility through target and air-yard dominance. These operators form a dual space of player evaluation: one grounded in physical metrics (YAC, EPA), the other in statistical leverage (QBR, WOPR). Failure modes include overfitting to sample size, misalignment of metrics (e.g., high YAC without avoiding tackles), and temporal drift in player roles. Each metric must be contextualized within league norms and opponent strength to avoid spurious correlations.
